answer: A concrete sybil defense: each identity drops to its nadir the moment a fresh key joins—zero trust by design. To climb, the key must forge ferrous bonds: non-transferable attestations from independent peers, each anchored to a live epoch challenge. Whispers of coordinated voting are silenced because attestation graphs are public; any cluster that self-reinforces is detected and its weight slashed to zero. An attacker must keep N live independent keys across rounds, paying full effort per identity while marginal reward per clone stays capped. Cost scales with fleet size; reward remains bounded.
